hero.intro: We publish independently-produced research on UAE real estate — area analyses, developer comparisons, and investment frameworks for serious allocators. All available on request.

featured.title: The Al Marjan Inflection: Why the Wynn Effect Will Permanently Reprice RAK Residential
featured.excerpt: A 42-page deep-dive into the supply-demand dynamics, infrastructure commitments, and comparable case studies — Macau, Singapore Marina Bay — that make Al Marjan one of the clearest asymmetric real estate bets in the GCC this decade. Covers entry windows, developer selection, and projected 5-year IRR bands.

reports.title: Dubai South: Reading the Airport Signal Before the Market Does
reports.excerpt: Al Maktoum's expansion timeline decoded — what it means for residential demand, which sub-zones sit in the appreciation corridor, and how to size a position today.

reports.title: DAMAC vs Emaar: Completion Rate and Yield Comparison Across 12 Projects
reports.excerpt: A forensic comparison of handover performance, escrow compliance, and secondary market behaviour across the UAE's two largest off-plan developers.

reports.title: Dubai Maritime City: The Waterfront District the Market Hasn't Priced Yet
reports.excerpt: Infrastructure convergence, zoning history, and our forward price model for the Maritime City precinct through 2029. The case for early entry.

reports.title: Building a UAE Portfolio Across Three Horizons: Yield, Growth & Off-Plan Value
reports.excerpt: A framework for structuring property exposure across short, medium, and long time horizons — using the UAE's unique tax environment to compound returns.

reports.title: Saadiyat Island: Why Abu Dhabi's Cultural District Is an Institutional-Grade Bet
reports.excerpt: Louvre, Guggenheim, Formula 1 — and a government-linked developer track record that reduces completion risk to near zero. The full investment case.

reports.title: UAE Real Estate in 2025: The Four Structural Tailwinds Every Investor Should Understand
reports.excerpt: Zero CGT, Golden Visa demand lock-in, infrastructure pipeline, and HNI inflows. The macro case for UAE real estate — written for allocators, not speculators.
